NONE: B1 going through or stopping at a place on the way to another place
B1 using a particular machine, system, or person to send or receive something

example: The London-Addis flight goes via Rome.
從倫敦到阿迪斯的航班要途經羅馬。
Reports are coming in via satellite.
報道透過衛星傳送進來。
I only found out about it via my sister.
我是從我姐姐那裡才知道了這件事。

NONE: › ability to work as intended or to succeed
› specialized biology ability to continue to exist or develop as a living being

example: Rising costs are threatening the viability of many businesses.
不斷上漲的成本正在威脅許多企業的生存。
As the world population of Hawaiian geese has shrunk to very small numbers, the bird's continuing viability is in doubt.
全球範圍內夏威夷雁已經所剩無幾，這種鳥能否繼續繁衍下去讓人懷疑。

NONE: C2 able to work as intended or able to succeed
可以實施的；可望成功的
› specialized biology able to continue to exist as or develop into a living being
能生長發育的；可以存活的

example: In order to make the company viable, it will unfortunately be necessary to reduce staffing levels.
很遺憾，為使公司繼續運轉下去，將不得不裁員。
I am afraid your plan is not commercially/economically/financially/politically viable.
恐怕你的計劃在商業／經濟／財政／政治上行不通。
There is a continuing debate about the age at which a human foetus can be considered viable.
關於人類胎兒在何時可被視為已有生命的問題仍處於爭論中。
